item.title: About
item.description:
« It’s not that we need new ideas, but we need to stop having old ideas. » Edwin Herbert Land

Welcome, bienvenue, willkommen

My name is Philippe-Anselme Foury currently working at Getinge.

Formely working for Therapixel.

I become a computer addict back in middle school (2007) where I had my first IT courses. It was not that common to have a lot of computers in schools, so I spent all my recess browsing the Internet looking for games tips and trying to download freewares on etajv. It was also the time when I create my first Excel spreadsheet tracking my pocket money expanses and my first Word document for my birhtday invitations.
